adversarialFindings.description: Earlier Zod backup validation could accumulate many diagnostics from malicious malformed unbounded history/Activity arrays, despite file-byte limits.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The reviewed candidate locks patched Zod 4.6.6 and uses per-row fail-fast validation with indexed error locations, strict envelope checks and cross-record invariants. Reported reproductions and focused regressions distinguish malformed large arrays from valid 20,000-row history. No evidence of partial restore acceptance was found in the reviewed source.

adversarialFindings.description: The initial Activity interface and shared mobile HUD/navigation presented usability defects: unreadable 320px totals, slow goal logging, excessive HUD height and overlapping bottom navigation labels under text enlargement.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Reviewed successor screenshots, source and focused UI tests show stacked mobile History totals, inline goal Save/Cancel, compact shared mobile HUD, and collision-free enlarged-text navigation while preserving desktop styling and accessible route labels. Real-device/screen-reader speech remains untested.

adversarialFindings.description: A new Activity database generation could corrupt educational progress or accept malformed and partly restored backups if schema migration or restore boundaries were unsafe.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Reviewed additive Dexie schema-5 upgrade and coordinated snapshot/restore/reset coverage; educational XP/mastery remains separate. Schema-4 exported backup refusal occurs before destructive restore. Implementer reports populated migration, atomic rollback and recovery tests passing. Live learner database testing remains an explicitly separate gate.

adversarialFindings.description: Nhost production still accepts schema 4 and has not run the schema-5 provider migration or real account/slot/permission/hash/restore tests. A new client cannot safely rely on schema-5 remote backup yet.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted as a deliberately excluded live rollout step, not claimed operational. No provider change or deployment is authorized by this review. Separately authorize migration, synthetic live validation, old-generation refusal and coordinated promotion; stop if live validation fails.

adversarialFindings.description: An existing browser upgraded to IndexedDB schema 5 cannot safely return to the older v1.8.0/schema-4 client; legacy schema-4 external backups are intentionally rejected by the new client.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted under the explicit owner schema policy. Preserve older backup rows and any needed schema-4 recovery copy; validate schema-5 local export/recovery and plan forward recovery instead of clearing browser data or assuming a simple downgrade. Treat production promotion as separately gated.
